operators.customDisplayName: Load data/archeology/input/roman_cities.csv via pd.read_csv (comma delimiter, header inferred from first row, UTF-8 encoding defaults)

Filter romanCities to rows with Country == 'Greece' (trimmed string); parse 'Barrington Atlas Rank' into numeric rankNum where '-' or blank -> null and values like '4 or 5' -> average of the two numbers; compute mean of rankNum across Greek cities and return avg_rank plus counts (n_cities, n_rank_nonnull) for validation
